name: Chronograph
description: The Chronograph MCP server allows users to query portfolio data, analyze investments, search for entities, retrieve performance metrics, and access Chronograph's help documentation. The connector is designed for private investment workflows, providing programmatic access to portfolio analytics and reporting data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Chronograph to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Chronograph to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.chronograph.pe/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Chronograph MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Chronograph provides these MCP tools: query-help-center-documentation, get-help-center-article, top-exposures, run-query, entity-search, commitment-history, and investment-metrics.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Chronograph?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Chronograph in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Chronograph requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Chronograph is developed by Chronograph. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
